svg.title: Three nested game loops in Relic Rush
svg.desc: The micro loop runs one to three seconds: react, choose a lane, jump or slide, get feedback. It sits inside the meso loop, which runs three to ten minutes: enter a biome, take the relic, survive the chunks, reach the exit, see the artifact reveal and star rating. That sits inside the macro loop, which runs across sessions: unlock biomes, grow the museum, upgrade the explorer.

g.text: unlock biomes on the map · grow the artifact museum · upgrade the explorer
enter a biome · take the relic · survive the chunks · reach the exit
ends on the artifact reveal and a star rating, so completion is the reward, not survival
read the incoming obstacle · pick a lane · jump or slide · get the feedback
the same loop as the original endless runner
what changed: it now happens inside a context
Each loop gives the one inside it a reason to exist. The micro loop was always fine. It had nothing around it.
MVP scope: three biomes, nine missions, four gadgets, a coin economy. A complete game at a small scale.
